drafts_today.text:
Last day at Sunnycrest Mall in Gibsons: I'm here today, 11 to 4.

Free self-applied facial, no purchase necessary.
Guess how many candies are in the tub. Closest guess wins at the end of the day.

Come say hi before the weather turns.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Straight-on phone photo of the candy tub front and centre with a guess slip and pen beside it, your Dermatology Booster EX, Serum EX and Dermatology Cream lined up behind. Mall daylight, no flash.
drafts_today.video_tip: 6-8 s vertical: tight on the candy tub, give it a slow turn, pull back to the whole table, end on you waving. On-screen text: 'Last day! Sunnycrest, Gibsons, 11-4'.

drafts_today.topic: Foundation settling into lines over 50 (Luminous Glow Cushion)
drafts_today.text:
Foundation settling into your fine lines after 50? It's usually the amount, not your face.

What I do instead:
1. Skincare first, and let it settle
2. Sunscreen underneath
3. RIMAN Luminous Glow Cushion: pat a thin layer, don't rub
4. Add more only where you want coverage

Save this for your next holiday party.
drafts_today.picture_tip: Open Luminous Glow Cushion with the puff resting on it, next to your Moisture Layer Sunscreen, on a vanity by a window. Soft daylight, no ring light needed.
drafts_today.video_tip: 10-12 s vertical: press the puff into the cushion, pat (not swipe) along one cheekbone, then a quick side-light shot of the finish. On-screen text: 'Pat, don't rub.' No voice needed.

drafts_today.topic: Hands and shins drier than your face (Suamel Body Cream)
drafts_today.text:
This week my hands and shins are drier than my face.

The one habit that helps:
body cream fresh out of the shower, every time. Neck down, small circles, until it sinks in.

Mine is RIMAN botalab Suamel Nourishing Body Cream.

What dries out first on you?
drafts_today.picture_tip: The Suamel Nourishing Body Cream jar on the bathroom counter with a folded towel and a slightly fogged mirror behind. Warm bathroom light.
drafts_today.video_tip: 6-8 s: scoop of body cream, massaged in circles on the back of the hand and forearm until absorbed. On-screen text: 'fresh out of the shower'. Keep it to hands/arms.
